name: Spriglet: Desktop Companion
subtitle: A little quiet company
description:
Meet Mallow, a soft lavender companion for your Mac. It rests beneath the notch with its face visible, blinking and breathing while you work.

INTERACT DIRECTLY
Hover to get a reaction. Click to invite. Drag to play. Click elsewhere to return home. A second touch gets a wave or a gentle swing. Release near its home to catch it, or farther away for gravity and a squishy landing.

QUIET BY DEFAULT
Mallow returns to its small peek after you move on. Transparent margins pass clicks through. Displays without a notch use an upper-right resting place. Reduce Motion limits decorative movement; Low Power Mode, display sleep and session changes are respected.

CONTROLS WITHIN REACH
Use the leaf in the menu bar to show or hide Mallow, pause or resume animation, bring it home, open Settings or Help, and quit Spriglet. Hidden Mallow is recoverable from the leaf menu or Finder.

MAKE IT YOURS
Open Settings from the leaf menu or by right-clicking Mallow. Choose character size, movement intensity and home display/location. Changes apply immediately and are saved on this Mac.

LOCAL BY DESIGN
No account, advertising, analytics or server connection. No screen capture or global keyboard monitoring. Plugins and assistant services are not active in this preview.

Requires an Apple silicon Mac with macOS 26 or later.
promotionalText: Meet Mallow: a soft, living companion beneath your notch. Hover, touch, drag and let it settle. Native, quiet and local.
reviewNotes:
This is the Mallow rewrite preview. It has no account, backend, payments, active plugins, login registration or special permissions. It appears directly in a transparent, nonactivating floating panel. It has no Dock icon or action cards.

Use the leaf in the menu bar to show or hide Mallow, pause or resume animation, bring it home, open Settings or Help, and quit Spriglet. Settings also offers Show and Animate controls for the running session. Help is available offline and preserves keyboard focus in the current app.

Hover to get a reaction. Click to invite. Drag to play. Click elsewhere to return home. Touch again to react; drag to play. Release near its home to catch; click elsewhere to return. A display without a notch uses an upper-right home below the menu bar.

Right-click Mallow to return it home and choose Settings… or Quit Spriglet from its small menu. Settings is an ordinary native window that activates only when explicitly requested. Character size, movement intensity and home display/location apply immediately and persist in local preferences. A missing selected display falls back without erasing the saved choice. Reduce Motion takes priority. Hidden Mallow stays hidden through sleep, lock and display changes. Choose Show Mallow or Bring Home, or reopen Spriglet from Finder to recover it. Bring Home and Finder recovery return it to its resting home and preserve Pause. Pause freezes the current pose and lets clicks pass through; pausing a drag releases it safely. Hide stops animation. Show, Bring Home and Finder recovery preserve Pause and keyboard focus. The app observes outside mouse clicks only to dismiss the character and reads no clicked content. It does not monitor global keyboard input. Reduce Motion limits decorative movement and animation suspends during system or display sleep, screen lock or an inactive session.

This metadata is for local preparation; this rewrite has not been submitted to Apple.
